align_cameras_extrinsics: align source cameras to target cameras using extrinsics mode with similarity transform estimation
align_cameras_centers: align source cameras to target cameras using camera centers mode with Umeyama algorithm
align_cameras_rigid: align source cameras to target cameras using rigid transform without scale estimation
review_corresponding_cameras_alignment: review the corresponding_cameras_alignment function to understand the similarity transform estimation between camera sets
summarize_align_camera_extrinsics: summarize the _align_camera_extrinsics function which uses SVD to compute global rotation and least squares for translation scale
